says: alice binds her laptop key, founds the Team Platform, binds the payments repository she works in, and registers and commits one personal knowledge source (glossary.md). Probes qualify delivery to a new session at launch on two installed hosts, Claude Code and Codex CLI. The entry is then driven from three entrances: from studio_hub (the Team's scope, through the hub's prepare job), from host_launcher (the repository's scope) and from setup (her personal scope). Each entrance's route.offer offers two start routes in that entrance's own scope, one per host, each qualified by its host's probe. In each drive the material and the tool are separate elements: Space on the personal knowledge position makes it selected and leaves the tool's value Codex CLI, still a suggestion; the right arrow changes the tool to Claude Code and leaves the knowledge position selected, and the permissions stay the host's own settings, a suggestion. Enter on the one start action dispatches one preparation.compose request over that entrance's scope and her personal scope, pinning the knowledge revision she selected; the owner composes a preparation holding that knowledge unit, and route.select names that entrance's Claude Code start route (and so its scope) and that request, expecting it prepared; the owner answers with a real run. No entrance starts in another entrance's scope, and no frame shows one choice changing the other's value.

set.value: The new session gave the code the adapter handed it in the instructions its host was started with.
